title: New World Spotlight and emails re-cut to the design: mixed-case type, the rating line, kit words in every email, white button labels

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 07:11Z New World polish pass; the handoff's reference/Spotlight Layouts.html and ui_kits/products/EmailPage.html

detail:
Side by side with the handoff, the six Spotlight layouts set every heading in capitals (the design's default voice is mixed case), had no rating line under the hero, let a long hero title run under the name on Stack, and drew the Card wall's next-open button in the accent where the design has a light pill. The kit emails used Services' quote and steps, a generic button, "Your reads every message" on the template, and ink labels on the accent button against Daniel's white-label rule.

Shipped: mixed-case display type and names; a five-star rating line (sample only, the kit's one count) on Stack, Card wall and the Profile review; the Stack name in flow above the title; the light next-open pill. Emails read the kit's own record through newWorldKitEmailFrom (its button, first offer, next opening and quote), welcome steps are New World's own, no quote card without a quote, the owner placeholder reads whole, the accent button carries white unless the accent is too light, and the page panel is flat as in the design. Held by components/spotlight/new-world-kit-layouts.test.tsx and lib/theme/new-world-kit-email.test.ts.

Spotlight layouts and kit emails re-cut to the handoff; probe passes.
